Approved mock v3 / built Android

Production screens in a release APK on Android API 36. Fixture state replay: no real sign-in, account enrollment or live workspace. Deep links select recorded helper states between screens. The reaching timer runs for a real minute, without changing the clock. The recording includes the whole wait. Chrome is opened only to an invalid example address; the connected row is a separate fixture state.
